lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere gun gaavahi sahaj samaavahi sabade mel milaae ||
lines.translation: Singing Your Glorious Praises, they merge naturally into You, O Lord; through the Shabad, they are united in Union with You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saphal janam tin keraa j satigur har maarag paae ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, their lives are fruitful; the True Guru places them on the Lord's Path. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat siu mel bhaiaa har har naam samaae raam ||
lines.translation: Those who join the Society of the Saints are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sad jeevan mukat bhae har kai naam liv laae raam ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are forever 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive; they are lovingly absorbed in the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam chit laae gur mel milaae manooaa rataa har naale ||
lines.translation: They center their consciousness on the Lord's Name; through the Guru, they are united in His Union. Their minds are imbued with the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaataa paaiaa mohu chukaaiaa anadin naam samhaale ||
lines.translation: They find the Lord, the Giver of peace, and they eradicate attachments; night and day, they contemplate the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabade raataa sahaje maataa naam man vasaae ||
lines.translation: They are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial peace; the Naam abides in their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin ghar sad hee sohilaa j satigur sev samaae ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the homes of their hearts are filled with happiness, forever and always; they are absorbed in serving the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur jag bharam bhulaaiaa har kaa mahal na paaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, the world is deluded by doubt; it does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhe ik mel milaaiaa tin ke dookh gavaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, some are united in the Lord's Union, and their pains are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin ke dookh gavaaiaa jaa har man bhaaiaa sadaa gaavahi ra(n)g raate ||
lines.translation: Their pains are dispelled, when it is pleasing to the Lord's Mind; imbued with His Love, they sing His Praises forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke bhagat sadaa jan niramal jug jug sad hee jaate ||
lines.translation: The Lord's devotees are pure and humble forever; throughout the ages, they are forever respected.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachee bhagat karahi dar jaapahi ghar dar sachaa soee ||
lines.translation: They perform true devotional worship service, and are honored in the Lord's Court; the True Lord is their hearth and home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sohilaa sachee sach baanee sabade hee sukh hoee ||4||4||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, true are their songs of joy, and true is their word; through the Word of the Shabad, they find peace. ||4||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: je loRahi var baalaReee taa gur charanee chit laae raam ||
lines.translation: If you long for your Husband Lord, O young and innocent bride, then focus your consciousness on the Guru's feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa hovahi sohaaganee har jeeu marai na jaae raam ||
lines.translation: You shall be a happy soul bride of your Dear Lord forever; He does not die or leave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu marai na jaae gur kai sahaj subhaae saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord does not die, and He does not leave; through the peaceful poise of the Guru, the soul bride becomes the lover of her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)jam sadaa hai niramal gur kai sabad seegaaree ||
lines.translation: Through truth and self-control, she is forever immaculate and pure; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa sad hee saachaa jin aape aap upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: My God is True, forever and ever; He Himself created Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa pir raave aapanaa jin gur charanee chit laaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she who focuses her consciousness on the Guru's feet, enjoys her Husband Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir paaiaRaa baalaReee anadin sahaje maatee raam ||
lines.translation: When the young, innocent bride finds her Husband Lord, she is automatically intoxicated with Him, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee man anad bhaiaa tit tan mail na raatee raam ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes blissful, and her body is not tinged with filth at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit tan mail na raatee har prabh raatee meraa prabh mel milaae ||
lines.translation: Her body is not tinged with filth at all, and she is imbued with her Lord God; my God unites her in Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin raave har prabh apanaa vichahu aap gavaae ||
lines.translation: Night and day, she enjoys her Lord God; her egotism is banished from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat paaiaa sahaj milaaiaa apane preetam raatee ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, she easily finds and meets Him. She is imbued with her Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee prabh raave ra(n)g raatee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, she obtains glorious greatness. She ravishes and enjoys her God; she is imbued with His Love. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir raave ra(n)g raataReee pir kaa mahal tin paaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Ravishing her Husband Lord, she is imbued with His Love; she obtains the Mansion of His Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੋ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: so saho at niramal daataa jin vichahu aap gavaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: She is utterly immaculate and pure; the Great Giver banishes self-conceit from within her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichahu mohu chukaaiaa jaa har bhaaiaa har kaaman man bhaanee ||
lines.translation: The Lord drives out attachment from within her, when it pleases Him. The soul bride becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin gun gaavai nit saache kathe akath kahaanee ||
lines.translation: Night and day, she continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; she speaks the Unspoken Speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug chaare saachaa eko varatai bin gur kinai na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Throughout the four ages, the One True Lord is permeating and pervading; without the Guru, no one finds Him.
